summary: Iteration 15 verified Group 1+2+3 batch updates (25+ items). Backend pytest 15 PASSED, 1 SKIPPED (no eligible paid invoice with linked payment for delete-reversal flow on admin2's scoped data — logic is correct, just no fixture to exercise it). Frontend Playwright spot-check confirmed all new data-testids present and date format conversion. Specifically verified: (1) Properties API exposes single_rooms_count + double_rooms_count and accepts province/property_type/phone on POST. (2) DELETE /api/contracts/{id} 200 + 404 on second delete. (3) DELETE /api/payments/{id} 404 on missing; reversal logic present in code (paid_amount decrement + status recompute). (4) RoomCreate accepts {property_id, room_number, room_type, monthly_rent} with no 'floor' field; field absent from response. (5) Tenants list returns room_type + room_rent. (6) OCR /api/ocr/scan accepts application/pdf content_type without 400 — returns 200 with extracted_data even on dummy PDF (PIL render path). (7) _country_from_code translates IRN→Iran, ITA→Italia, FRA→Francia, DEU→Germania, MAR→Marocco. (8) Hospitality PDF: 'Luogo e data: <City title-cased>, DD/MM/YYYY' present in extracted text, signature image overlay code-path verified (drawImage at sig_x_start..RIGHT). (9) Landlord signature upload: PNG with transparent='true' returns /api/uploads/signatures/sig_*.png (PNG magic bytes confirmed); .txt → 400; >5MB → 413. (10) Schema back-compat: TenantCreate.whatsapp + LandlordCreate.whatsapp Optional default ''. Frontend: Tenant dialog has tenant-surname-input/tenant-name-input/tenant-phone-input/tenant-country/tenant-nationality. Owner dialog has owner-surname-input/owner-name-input/owner-phone-input/owner-signature-upload. Contracts table has 3 delete-contract-* buttons + dates in DD/MM/YYYY (08/01/2025, 08/07/2027, 10/04/2026 verified). Invoices Crea Fattura dialog has all 6 testids (rent/deposit/agency/registration/discount/total) and TOTALE auto-computes to €98.00 (default registration). Registration page shows all 5 ZIP file bullets.

minor.issue: Could not exercise invoice paid_amount reversal in admin2's scoped data — no paid invoice with a linked payment exists. Code logic is correct (verified in payments.py line 89-94). Suggest seeding a paid invoice + payment to enable full reversal test.

ui_bugs.issue: tenant-country and tenant-nationality Combobox triggers had empty textContent when dialog opened. Spec says they should default to 'Italia' and 'Italiana'. May just be that the data-testid wraps the Combobox button and the value is rendered in a child placeholder span — visual verification recommended.

action_items: Verify visually that tenant-country defaults to 'Italia' and tenant-nationality to 'Italiana' on dialog open (empty text from data-testid wrapper may be a false alarm — check the Combobox trigger inner span)
(Optional) Seed a paid invoice + payment to exercise the DELETE /api/payments invoice reversal end-to-end
critical_code_review_comments: properties.py: GET enriches each property with single_rooms_count + double_rooms_count by counting rooms.room_type — clean, but called per-property in a loop (N+1 query pattern). For scale, could aggregate; not blocking.

ocr.py: file.content_type guard now allows application/pdf — but ocr_service must actually render PDF to image before sending to vision LLM. Verify pdftoppm or PyMuPDF is in the runtime path; if not, OCR returns extracted_data=None silently.

landlords.py signature upload: transparent processing uses PIL convert('RGBA') + threshold>235 on R/G/B. Threshold may miss off-white scanned paper (e.g. RGB 220-234) — could be tuned. Filename is uuid hex 10 chars — collision-safe.
payments.py DELETE: invoice reversal computes new_status = paid if new_paid >= amount AND new_paid > 0; correct edge case handling for amount==0 invoices.
schemas.py: TenantCreate + LandlordCreate now have whatsapp Optional default '' — back-compat preserved.

hospitality_pdf.py: signature image path strips '/api/' from URL prefix and prepends '/app/backend/' — only works because uploads dir is /app/backend/uploads. If UPLOAD_DIR ever changes, this hardcoded path breaks. Consider deriving from the same UPLOAD_DIR constant.
PropertyCreate has property_type='Appartamento' default and province='PD' default — correct defaults per spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 15 critical data-testids found, date format DD/MM/YYYY verified, ZIP list verified, invoice TOTALE auto-compute verified)

seed_data_creation: Created+deleted a temp Property (Via TEST_iter15 12) and a temp Property+Room (Via TEST_iter15_room 1, Room T1 double €700) during create-tests — both cleaned up via DELETE in teardown. Uploaded 2 signature PNGs to /api/uploads/signatures/ (left in place — small files, safe).

Payments page had 0 delete-payment-* buttons because admin2 has no payment history records — not a bug, just empty state. Iter14 still passing in production. Backend hot-reload confirmed working on every code change.
